properties.label: Distant-seam closing composition
properties.text: Place an emphatic centred closing statement above a small command action, with a very fine light seam much lower in the frame and sparse aligned metadata completing the composition.

properties.label: Large neutral closing type
properties.text: Make large neutral sans typography the primary visual object.

properties.label: Blue-black with electric seam
properties.text: Use blue-black, soft white and one electric-blue seam.

properties.label: Feathered seam reflection
properties.text: Give the seam a restrained halo and a long feathered reflection that adds depth without filling the empty stage with shapes.

properties.label: Still ending with local feedback
properties.text: Hold the composition still and give the action immediate local feedback; understanding must not depend on a long reveal.

properties.label: Type-to-seam tension acceptance
properties.text: Preserve the long visual distance between type and seam. Keep both visible on mobile and keep navigation clear of the final metadata.
